scope.input_scope: One DC source on any pair; other terminals open. Reversed polarity allowed. Multiple rails are reported as ambiguous.
scope.power: USB 5V and host 3V3 through J4 from the existing Waveshare module
scope.display: Waveshare ESP32-S3-LCD-1.28 via five-wire harness; module mechanically separate
scope.isolation: Functional isolation of all measurement electronics from USB; not mains/CAT rated
scope.accuracy: Design target +/-0.15V around 12V at room temperature after per-channel calibration; not a measured guarantee
